name: Sone Seira
source:
Seira has a weak body and spent a large part of her life hospitalized. Because of this, she becomes very distraught just by hearing the word "hospital" and will even hyperventilate; the only way she can calm down afterwards is by listening to music. Seira has been friends with her fellow Rock Band Club member [url=/c98206]Suzu[/url] since middle school.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
